L0511

Binding `err` shadows the fallback's ambient failure report

What

Binding `err` shadows the fallback's ambient failure report

Why

`err` has a special meaning inside a fallible `??` fallback, so the same name is easy to misread as the report there

Fix

rename the binding, or use it outside a fallback

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0511: tests/ui_lint/ambient_err_shadow.warn.

Warning [L0511] (err_fallback_shadow): binding `err` shadows the fallback's ambient failure report
  --> tests/ui_lint/ambient_err_shadow.jet:7:5
    |
  7 |     err :: "user binding"
    |     ^^^
 Why: `err` has a special meaning inside a fallible `??` fallback, so the same name is easy to misread as the report there
 Fix: rename the binding, or use it outside a fallback
